comparative_rules.n_writes: production-judged writes: judge-band rows whose recon_marker and declares_attach_keys are both false
comparative_rules.placeable_writes: production-judged writes with at least one pair resolved AGREEING or CORRECTS whose target predates the write (strictly earlier created_at; an undated record is never earlier)
comparative_rules.contradiction_writes: production-judged writes with at least one pair resolved CORRECTS whose target predates the write
comparative_rules.placeable_attaches: attaches of placeable writes whose pair resolved AGREEING, CORRECTS or MISFILE
comparative_rules.wrong_sibling_misfiles: attaches of placeable writes whose pair resolved MISFILE: the write had an earlier home and the arm filed it under another record
comparative_rules.wrong_sibling_rate_placeable: wrong_sibling_misfiles / placeable_attaches; None when placeable_attaches is 0
comparative_rules.wrong_sibling_rate_wilson95: Wilson 95% interval (z = 1.96) on wrong_sibling_misfiles of placeable_attaches; None when placeable_attaches is 0
comparative_rules.no_known_home_attaches: attaches whose pair resolved AGREEING, CORRECTS or MISFILE, of writes that are not placeable
comparative_rules.unclear_attaches: attaches whose pair resolved UNCLEAR; outside every other figure and every outcome cell
comparative_rules.outcomes: per regime, the production-judged writes in each cell; one write may fall in two cells. status_quo stores every write flat; arm is what this arm did
comparative_rules.harm_weights: the weight of each outcome cell, as passed to the scorer; a cell left out weighs 0 (PRD §12 D20, provisional)
comparative_rules.harm_total: per regime, the sum over cells of harm_weights[cell] x outcomes[regime][cell]; None when n_writes is 0
comparative_rules.harm_delta_vs_status_quo: harm_total.arm - harm_total.status_quo, on the same writes; at most 0 means no more harm than storing every write flat; None when n_writes is 0
comparative_rules.harm_delta_bootstrap95: paired bootstrap 95% interval of harm_delta_vs_status_quo, reported and not gated: each production-judged write contributes its arm harm minus its status-quo harm; the writes, ordered by memory_id, are resampled with replacement bootstrap.resamples times from random.Random(bootstrap.seed), and the interval is the nearest-rank 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of the resampled sums; None when n_writes is 0
comparative_rules.bootstrap: the settings harm_delta_bootstrap95 was computed with
comparative_rules.attach_belongs: attached, not filed contested, pair resolved AGREEING
comparative_rules.contradiction_unflagged: a contradiction write that was not filed contested against a target resolved CORRECTS, whatever else the regime did with it
comparative_rules.misfile_attach: attached, not filed contested, pair resolved MISFILE
